attr.title: Slipstream
attr.desc: An arcade racer in the spirit of the late 80s and early 90s: drift and draft behind rivals across 20 tracks around the world, in a Grand Tour with branching paths, a Grand Prix with car upgrades, Cannonball runs, Battle Royale and time trials.
attr.inst: Requires the Linux version of the game from Steam. To get it on any OS, open steam://open/console in a browser and enter: download_depot 732810 732812. When Steam prints "Depot download complete", the files are in Steam/steamapps/content/app_732810/depot_732812/. Copy all files and folders from the game's folder into ports/slipstream/gamedata/. To install the free Blue Hour DLC, download it on Steam before copying the game, or copy the assets/content/blue-hour/ folder from the game's folder into ports/slipstream/gamedata/assets/content/ later. The folder from the Windows version works too.
